# Reviewer verdict: PASS

PR #233, round 2 (final under C34), exact head
`3df646daa82a85804968bead3d5136cb8bb714aa`.
Reviewed only the three-file delta from `1bf90e1`.
**0 blocking findings; no remaining findings.**

1. **P2 resolved — `skills/pij/tools/fleet-map/templates/index.html:1194`.**
   `verdictHtml()` explicitly distinguishes true, false and unknown. Unknown
   shows an escaped SHA without a freshness claim; only false is marked stale.
   The stop card uses that helper at line 1214. The no-gh fixture now asserts
   its HTML output at `harness/scripts/fleet-map.test.ts:417`; known current
   and older heads remain covered at line 366. Reintroducing the original
   unknown-as-stale behavior in an isolated copy fails the no-gh test.

2. **P3 resolved — `harness/scripts/fleet-map.test.ts:148`.**
   The new test executes the template's actual `builtSpans()` and asserts
   isolated and adjacent out-of-order merges, the terminal merged stop,
   unchanged in-order behavior, all-merged and none-merged cases. Restoring
   the original last-merged cutoff in an isolated copy now fails that test.

**Validation:** `just pr-freeze 233 --worktree` and the final
`just pr-freeze 233` both report FINAL at this head, all five CI checks passed,
and the detached worktree is clean. After isolated locked dependency replay,
`nice -n 19 just test harness/scripts/fleet-map.test.ts` passes **11/11**.
Both serial mutation runs used nice and one worker; each produced exactly
**1 intended failure, 1 pass, 9 skipped**. Mutation copies were removed;
reviewed implementation files were never changed.

Full harness checks were **not rerun**, as requested; CI at the exact head
is the broader proof. No new steady-state cost, launch site, timer, poll or
per-seat work is introduced by this delta. The README accurately describes
the corrected unknown-head behavior.

**Harness improvement:** both round-1 gaps now have executable regression
coverage in the existing suite, without a browser dependency.
